rachael: hey folks, new hire here (rachael). trying to build the inference runtime from source on Ubuntu 22.04 WSL2 with an RTX 3070. following the devex guide but hit compile errors. any quick debugging tips? :wave:

sam: welcome! paste the first error and `nvcc --version` + `nvidia-smi` please. WSL can hide libcuda under /usr/lib/wsl which trips the linker.

rachael: thanks. nvcc shows Cuda compilation tools, release 12.1, V12.1.85, nvidia-smi driver 525, cuda 12.1. top errors:

```
/opt/cuda/include/host_config.h:56:10: fatal error: cuda_runtime_api.h: No such file or directory
 #include <cuda_runtime_api.h>
/usr/bin/ld: cannot find -lcuda
nvcc: error: unsupported GNU version! gcc versions later than 11 are not supported by this release.
```

sam: three things: (1) looks like cmake picked /opt/cuda includes; our toolkit is usually under /usr/local/cuda-12.1. (2) libcuda missing at link -> check /usr/lib/wsl. (3) gcc too new for nvcc.

infra: we have a gpu-dev VM you can borrow 24h. faster than debugging WSL. ping infra with "gpu-quick" and I'll allocate.

devex: quick commands to try on WSL if you want to continue:

```bash
export CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-12.1
export PATH=$CUDA_HOME/bin:$PATH
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=$CUDA_HOME/lib64:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
which nvcc && nvcc --version
gcc --version
ls -l /usr/lib/wsl/libcuda.so*
rm -rf build && mkdir build && cd build && cmake .. -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=/usr/bin/gcc-11 -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=/usr/bin/g++-11 -DCUDA_TOOLKIT_ROOT_DIR=$CUDA_HOME && make -j$(nproc)
```

rachael: ran ls -l and only found /usr/lib/wsl/libcuda.so -> /proc/driver/nvidia/000. CUDA_HOME was empty. set the envs and tried cmake; now cmake finds CUDA but link still fails on -lcuda. i'll take the infra VM — less friction. thanks for the commands and tips!

sam: +1 to VM. also open a quick devex PR to add a WSL note (recommend container/VM for GPU builds). good first-week bug to fix in docs.

infra: allocated VM ticket DEVVM-604, sent creds via email. enjoy and ping here if anything odd shows up on the VM.
